sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Plated Dainty Nath – Sparkling White Stone Studded
sourceNotes.rawContent: Complete your ethnic look with this stunning gold-toned nath, featuring a delicate circle of shimmering white stones and a dainty teardrop charm. To maintain its radiant golden luster and high-fashion finish, avoid contact with moisture or perfumes and store it safely in a dry place after use.
